title: Dallas Fed Trimmed Mean PCE (Sep 2026 data) — the energy-shock month read on a gauge that trims energy out
source: EST: dallasfed.org/research/pce re-fetched direct 2026-09-29 states verbatim that "Updates to the Trimmed Mean PCE Inflation Rate follow BEA's release schedule for Personal Income and Outlays data," unchanged from the 2026-09-15 read, still carrying July 2026 data (1-month 2.2%, 6-month 2.3%, 12-month 2.3%) with next update "Sept. 30." bea.gov/news/schedule, re-fetched direct 2026-09-29, reads verbatim "October 29 8:30 AM · News · Personal Income and Outlays, September 2026," same slot as the Q3 2026 GDP advance estimate. Filed `estimate`: the date is derived from a publisher's stated rule rather than read off a dated Dallas Fed calendar row (the same derivation shape eia-weekly-petroleum-status-2026-09-16 recorded, and distinct from the FRB: dated-table gap #3117 closed for dallas-fed-tssos-2026-09-29), this file's confirmed-prefix taxonomy defines no prefix for a regional Reserve Bank research release, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it did not discover. notes: Discovered during the pce-2026-10-29 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-15, D-44); initial research completed 2026-09-29 (D-30). Sibling to dallas-fed-trimmed-mean-2026-09-30, which covers the BEA annual-revision effect on restated months; this event covers the first calendar month (September 2026) computed natively under the revised methodology, and the month the energy tail actually moved (EIA weekly regular gasoline $4.071 08-31 -> $4.478 09-21, +10% in three weeks; Brent peaked $108.75 09-15 then reversed to $99.39 09-29). Initial research computed fresh from FRED (583 months, 1978-2026-07) that the headline-minus-trim wedge is 1.42pp in July 2026 (92.5th percentile of 48 years) and correlates r=0.822 with the headline-minus-core food/energy spread -- composing with the sibling ledger's independently-found 95.7th-percentile core-minus-trim wedge to suggest the gauge is reading low for more than ordinary energy-tail reasons.
